title: 12 Best Bordeaux Natural Wine Bars
description: Explore Bordeaux's vibrant natural wine scene. Discover the top 12 bars and restaurants serving unfiltered, organic, and biodynamic wines in Bordeaux, France.

places.name: Le Flacon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of their current natural wine selections, paired with the regional charcuterie board.

places.name: Horace
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their 'assiettes à partager' (sharing plates) with a recommendation from the sommelier for a biodynamic red.

places.name: Chez les Girondins
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of Gamay natural wine from Beaujolais and their homemade pâté de campagne.

places.name: La Ligne Rouge
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their organic hummus plate and a glass of pét-nat (pétillant naturel) from the Loire Valley.

places.name: La Conserverie – Cave à Manger
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A selection of gourmet tinned sardines or mackerel with crusty bread and a crisp, mineral-driven natural white wine.

places.name: Vins Urbains
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a tasting of regional natural wines you've never tried before, accompanied by a small cheese plate.

places.name: P'tit Bagarre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their daily special 'plat du jour' and whatever natural red wine the server suggests to go with it.

places.name: Mâche
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tasting menu with the natural wine pairing option for a comprehensive experience.

places.name: Le Soler
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their fresh seafood small plates, paired with a lively natural white wine from the Roussillon region.

places.name: L'Influence
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cheese and charcuterie board to share, accompanied by a robust, low-tannin natural red wine.

places.name: Le Verre Y Table
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their seasonal main courses like duck confit, paired with a natural Bordeaux red.

places.name: Le Chien de Pavlov
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Trust the chef's tasting menu ('Menu Carte Blanche') and let the sommelier guide your natural wine pairings.
